encode_sequence: encode a protein amino acid sequence string into a numpy array of integer indices
compute_kl_divergence: compute the KL divergence of a protein sequence against learned ngram frequency distributions
load_ngram_stats: load monogram, bigram, trigram, and quadgram pickle stats from the ngram_stats directory
normalize_ngram_frequencies: normalize ngram frequency counts into probability distributions with a minimum floor value
review_ngram_module: review the ngram utility module that encodes sequences and computes KL divergence for protein design
